# CurrentDate

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Time & Date](Language-Features-Time-and-Date)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CurrentDate:String
```

**Returns:** The date as text.

## Description

Returns today's date from the system clock as day, abbreviated month and year, for example `26 Oct 2026`.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "Today is " + CurrentDate$()
```
